text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Average of a Set of Data: p. 44; Decimals, Multiplication and Division: p. 38.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。一组数据的平均数：第 44 页；小数的乘除：第 38 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines are quoted from it (pages as printed on the PDF, read 2026-11-15). The division sign in "total value ÷ number of data" was checked on the page image of p. 44.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课纲条目照原文引用（页码是 PDF 上印的页码，2026-11-15 读取）。“total value ÷ number of data”里的除号已对照第 44 页的原图核过。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面。

note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: approved textbook list (for the usual order of topics only, not copied).
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：批准教材目录（只参考通常的教学顺序，不照抄）。

note.en: Questions, pictures and wording in this lesson are our own; every number is made up.
note.zh: 本课的题目、插图和措辞都是自己写的；所有数字都是虚构的。

text.en: Mokros, J. & Russell, S. J. (1995). Children's concepts of average and representativeness. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 26(1), 20–39 (ERIC EJ496903).
text.zh: Mokros, J. 与 Russell, S. J.（1995）：儿童对平均数与代表性的理解。《数学教育研究杂志》（JRME）第 26 卷第 1 期，20–39 页（ERIC EJ496903）。

note.en: Interviews with 21 pupils in grades 4, 6 and 8 found average taken as the most common value, as a procedure, as what is reasonable, as the midpoint, or as a point of balance (the code average-as-middle; the levelling picture of evening out). Read from the ERIC abstract. Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 访谈 21 名四、六、八年级学生，发现他们把平均数理解为出现最多的数、一套算法、合理的数、中间的数或平衡点（误解码 average-as-middle；移多补少的画面）。读的是 ERIC 摘要。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。

text.en: Pollatsek, A., Lima, S. & Well, A. D. (1981). Concept or computation: Students' understanding of the mean. Educational Studies in Mathematics 12(2), 191–204.
text.zh: Pollatsek, A.、Lima, S. 与 Well, A. D.（1981）：概念还是计算——学生对平均数的理解。《数学教育研究》第 12 卷第 2 期，191–204 页。

note.en: Asked to combine the means of two groups of different sizes, most simply averaged the two means (the code averages-averaged). The students were at college, not primary school. Read from the publisher's abstract. Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 要把两组人数不同的平均数合起来时，多数人直接把两个平均数再平均（误解码 averages-averaged）。研究对象是大学生，不是小学生。读的是出版社摘要。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。
